2608.27427.title: Persona-Execution Separation: An Architecture Pattern for Evolving LLM Agents under Execution Audit
2608.27427.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents in governed organizations must let the persona (instructions, tone, self-presentation) evolve freely, while keeping execution (stateful, audited work) traceable. A single trust domain does not satisfy both cheaply. We present Persona-Execution Separation (PES): persona and execution reside in different trust domains, connected by a governed contract bridge. The persona is singly-homed and may drift; execution is faceless and audited. Status summaries may return; data bodies remain in the restrictive domain except a graded data-loss-prevention (DLP) exception; identity stays continuous. An approval matrix, DLP, and audit enforce the crossing. PES follows from three goals---free drift, execution traceability, and decoupling. Under LLM representational indistinguishability, any single-domain mechanism that meets all three must re-introduce typed change objects, an external gate, and a stable audit anchor: PES rebuilt at higher coupling cost. A development/pilot case in a regulated digital-employee platform records five decisions over one month, each with a rejected alternative. A mechanism check on the shipped implementation found no execution-side re-validation under persona perturbation (five model configurations) and no persona fingerprint on hard-asserted fields. A probe of a recovered pre-separation build found the governed execution path decoupled from the persona by omission, not by construction; a later wiring change could reverse that isolation, which PES makes an audited architectural rule. The pattern applies when multi-user deployment, execution audit, and expected persona churn hold jointly.
2608.27427.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在受管組織中必須讓角色（指示、語氣、自我呈現）自由演變，同時保持執行（有狀態的、經過審計的工作）可追溯。單一信任領域無法便宜地滿足這兩者。我們提出角色-執行分離（PES）：角色和執行位於不同的信任領域，通過受管的合約橋連接。角色是單一主機，可能會漂移；執行是無面孔的並且經過審計。狀態摘要可能會返回；數據主體保持在限制性領域，除了經過分級的數據丟失預防（DLP）例外；身份保持連續。一個批准矩陣、DLP和審計強制執行這一跨越。PES源於三個目標——自由漂移、執行可追溯性和解耦。在LLM表徵不可區分性下，任何滿足這三個條件的單一領域機制必須重新引入類型變更對象、一個外部閘道和一個穩定的審計錨點：PES以更高的耦合成本重建。在一個受管的數位員工平台中的開發/試點案例記錄了在一個月內的五個決策，每個決策都有被拒絕的替代方案。對發送實施的機制檢查發現，在角色擾動（五個模型配置）下，沒有執行端的重新驗證，並且在硬性斷言字段上沒有角色指紋。對一個恢復的預分離構建的探查發現，受管的執行路徑因省略而與角色解耦，而非因構造；稍後的接線變更可能會逆轉該隔離，這是PES所制定的一項經過審計的架構規則。當多用戶部署、執行審計和預期角色變動共同存在時，該模式適用。
